description: Convert YAML configuration files into formatted JSON instantly in your browser with real-time error validation.
faq_items: Why convert YAML to JSON?:::JSON is universally supported across APIs, databases, and frontend frameworks, making YAML-to-JSON conversion essential for deployment configs.|||Does this support nested YAML objects and arrays?:::Yes, it parses nested objects, key-value maps, and bulleted lists into valid JSON structures.|||Is my YAML data private?:::Yes, conversion is executed 100% locally in your browser with zero network requests.
related_tools: JSON Formatter,SQL Formatter & Beautifier,cURL to Python Converter

description: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (JWT) headers, payloads, and claims client-side without sending tokens to any server.
faq_items: Is it safe to paste production JWTs here?:::Yes, this tool decodes tokens purely in your browser memory using Base64URL parsing. No token is ever transmitted to a server.|||What parts of the JWT are displayed?:::It breaks down both the Header (algorithm, token type) and the Payload claims (sub, exp, iat, roles).|||Does it verify signatures?:::It inspects and formats the decoded JSON claims for debugging authentication payloads.

description: Compare two text snippets or code files side-by-side with visual line-by-line additions and deletion highlights.
faq_items: How does the diff checker highlight differences?:::It analyzes lines sequentially, highlighting removed lines in red and added lines in green.|||Can I compare large files?:::Yes, you can paste large code blocks or documents for instant comparison.|||Is my text secure?:::Yes, all line comparisons happen entirely in your local browser.

description: Generate full 50-950 Tailwind CSS color shade palettes from any hex color with 1-click config export.
faq_items: How are the 50 to 950 shades calculated?:::Shades are generated using balanced luminosity and tint curves optimized for Tailwind CSS design systems.|||Can I copy the tailwind.config.js snippet?:::Yes, click the generated configuration block to copy it to clipboard.|||Which color formats can I pick?:::Pick visually with the color picker or input custom HEX values.
related_tools: Color Picker,PX to REM Converter,CSS Minifier

description: Generate and decode standard cron schedule expressions with human-readable explanations and quick presets.
faq_items: What are the 5 fields in standard cron?:::The 5 fields represent minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week.|||What does */15 * * * * mean?:::It specifies an execution frequency of every 15 minutes.|||Can I copy cron strings for crontab?:::Yes, clicking any preset copies the exact string directly to clipboard.
related_tools: Unix Timestamp Converter,cURL to Python Converter,Regex Tester

description: Convert special characters, symbols, and quotes into safe HTML entities (&, <, >) to prevent XSS and formatting bugs.
faq_items: Why do special characters need HTML encoding?:::Characters like <, >, and & can be misparsed as HTML markup or trigger XSS vulnerabilities if not encoded.|||Does it convert unicode symbols and accents?:::Yes, it handles emojis, copyright symbols, and international unicode characters.|||Can I decode entity strings back to text?:::Yes, click the Decode button to restore plain text.

description: Transform JSON sample responses into strongly typed TypeScript interfaces with automatic type inference.
faq_items: How does type inference work?:::It detects primitives (string, number, boolean), nullables, and arrays automatically from your JSON keys.|||Can I export the interface?:::Yes, click Copy TypeScript to paste directly into your project's types.ts file.|||Is my API payload secure?:::All parsing is done in-browser without sending data to any external backend.
related_tools: JSON Formatter,YAML to JSON Converter,cURL to Python Converter

description: Minify SVG vector graphics, strip redundant comments and whitespace, and preview rendered vector graphics live.
faq_items: How does SVG optimization reduce size?:::It strips editor metadata, XML comments, and redundant spacing while keeping vector paths intact.|||Can I preview the SVG live?:::Yes, the viewer renders your SVG vector in real-time as you optimize.|||Is it safe for production icons?:::Yes, all viewbox coordinates and path definitions are preserved.
related_tools: Color Picker,HTML Minifier,PX to REM Converter

description: Calculate Linux/Unix file permissions numerically (755, 644) and symbolic notation (rwxr-xr-x) with interactive checkboxes.
faq_items: What does chmod 755 mean?:::755 grants Read, Write, and Execute to the owner, and Read + Execute to group and others.|||What is the standard permission for web files?:::Usually 644 for regular files (rw-r--r--) and 755 for directories.|||How does numerical octal work?:::Read = 4, Write = 2, Execute = 1. Add them together for each user category.
related_tools: Cron Expression Generator,Unix Timestamp Converter,Hash Generator

description: Generate cryptographically secure, random passwords and passphrases locally in your browser using the Web Crypto API.
faq_items: Are these passwords generated securely?:::Yes, passwords are created using window.crypto.getRandomValues(), the gold standard for cryptographic randomness.|||Are passwords stored or sent anywhere?:::Never. Passwords exist solely in your browser memory and vanish when cleared.|||Can I customize character types?:::Yes, toggle uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special symbols with custom length.
